summary: Source Workbench administrative Job/Result Save and Delete publish late success or failure feedback only while their workspace revision and effective API authority remain current. Accepted intent is captured synchronously before the queued write; suppressed duplicates do not supersede it. Message publication, navigation, manual record selection and workspace disposal invalidate feedback, while confirmed same-authority cleanup and read recovery remain independent. Effective URL and governed auth-header comparison prevents an old write from modifying same-ID records or starting follow-up reads on another backend; job/result reads discard old-authority replies even without a newer read. Twenty-four mocked-service Chromium controls and sixteen added frontend controls verify this bounded source-client behavior. This is not installed WebView acceptance, authenticated remote deployment, continuous authority-history fencing, ambiguous-write reconciliation, cancellation, cross-client locking, exactly-once execution or operational-grade qualification. No persistent snapshot, backup, write replay or production Node dependency is introduced.

required_text: captures feedback at acceptance before its queued write starts
manual selection ABA cannot revive an old feedback owner
old write confirmation must not start follow-up reads on another authority
the same record ID on the new authority must remain visible
does not cancel or roll back a backend write
